title: fix: drop Qwen Image 3's single-image Replicate fallback
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed Replicate's `alibaba/qwen-image-3` fallback because it accepts only one image URL: requests with 2–3 reference images could use only the first while billing for all of them. Qwen Image 3 retains DashScope as its primary route and fal as its fallback; both accept up to 3 images. If both routes fail, the request returns an upstream error without billing rather than sending a partial request to Replicate.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, two flower-lined paths labeled DashScope and fal carry a bundle of three reference pictures toward a glowing image frame, while Polli gently closes a third path that would take only one; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among warm cream, mint, and lavender pastels, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny route-mapper's cap, stays small-to-medium within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic.
